title: Issue #24 - Agent Review Hub, helper audit, navigation IA, and newest Drive recording trace

source_statements.source_statement: Issue #24 extends the canonical issue #7 ramble-to-execution system and must not create a second task manager, helper architecture, queue, agent fleet, memory system, or active-run pointer.
Confirm current master, deployed SHA, Railway deployment, live health, active-run status, worktrees, and queue state before implementation.

Register Issue #24 idempotently as one raw source and one parent goal, create one parent execution run, and isolate coordinated lanes for review hub, helpers, prompts, navigation, Drive trace, and release.

Perform a read-only production trace of the newest matching Drive recording through discovery, content job, transcription, parsing, class/student linkage, questions, scores/progress/accountability, Operations visibility, parent/student visibility, duplicate/idempotency state, and blockers.
Preserve Issue #18's NOT SAFE TO APPLY guardrail; do not apply class backfill, move Drive files, paid retranscribe, retry production workers, or mutate student data.

Build an owner-only Agent Review Hub with explicit role/workspace cards and short-lived auditable review sessions that require owner auth, avoid reusable secrets in URLs, show a Reviewing-as banner, and provide Exit.
Make the Agent Review Hub practical for ChatGPT Agent on mobile while documenting that external sites and local Playwright profiles remain separate login/cookie contexts.
Inventory and test every helper/bot surface, including public, Operations, provider/Rabbi, provider participant, parent, student, One Time member/classroom, and Telegram adapters where applicable.

Every internal link returned by a helper must be produced by the canonical route/action resolver and verified for route key, canonical path, role, workspace, project, section, landmark, authorization, and fallback.

Create human-like conversation evaluations with realistic paraphrases, follow-ups, wrong-role/wrong-workspace requests, safe actions, unsupported actions, link following, write readback, and PASS/FAIL evidence.
Create separate mobile-copyable Agent Mode prompt files and expose them from the owner walkthrough or Agent Review Hub.
Add Submit Agent Review Result in the hub and persist the result through the typed agent-result action/API with role/workspace/source/requirement/evidence/readback/idempotency metadata.

Refactor navigation IA so side navigation owns major modules and horizontal tabs only contain children, view modes, status filters, scoped subcategories, or record sections; add watchdog coverage for duplicate same-level targets.

Run required focused tests, helper planner/tool/permission tests, route/action/security audits, role-flow tests, navigation watchdog, visual/mobile checks, Agent Mode/manual browser evidence, result drop-off readback, newest Drive trace, tenant/privacy tests, secrets audit, full npm test, and Railway deploy/live smoke.

Do not hand off to owner Agent Mode testing until live review hub URL, scoped review sessions, no URL all-access secret, review banner/Exit, Submit Agent Review Result persistence, helper reachability, prompt files, resolver wiring, newest-recording trace status, tests, deployment, and live smokes all pass.

Review banner and Exit work in each review context.
Public/wrong-role/error states are testable without data leakage.
Hub is usable from ChatGPT Agent after one owner login and documents separate external-site logins.
